# Velyr

Velyr is an AI growth agent that ships one weekly conversion fix as a GitHub Pull Request. Your code, your repo, your approval.

## What it does
- Analyzes your repo + PostHog analytics every Monday
- Identifies the #1 conversion problem across your funnel
- Writes the code fix and opens a Pull Request on your GitHub
- Sends a Telegram message — reply YES to deploy, NO to skip
- Auto-rolls-back if bounce rate spikes within 48h

## Who it's for
React, Next.js, or Vite sites on Vercel with a GitHub repo. Indie hackers, solo founders, small SaaS teams.

## Not supported
Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow — the agent edits source code and these site builders don't expose that.

## Pricing
€29/month after a 14-day free trial. Cancel anytime.
